en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.798 - Abu Jamila narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that

he asked him about wearing the garment of a Magian (Zoroastrian) and praying in it.
Abu Abdullah (as) replied: "Yes."

Then he asked: "But they drink wine."
He (as) said: "Yes, we buy Sabiriyyah garments (a type of fabric) and wear them without washing."
